summary:
**Status: partial** — parser, styling, layout, grid, navigation, sharing passthrough, and interaction tests are implemented and verified; docs updates, the shell e2e chapter, and the PDF body-text test are not yet done (turn limit).

## What was done

**Prior work check:** the worktree was clean at base `4104d2bb` — no prior edits survived, so the spec was restarted from the parser step.

**Parser (`src/logic/markdown/mod.rs`, +374):**
- `Link::Footnote(String)` variant added; `links()` merges footnote matches in text order (no overlaps by construction).
- `footnote_label` (1+ chars, no `]`, not whitespace-only, no `|`), `code_spans` (1+ backtick spans, unclosed = literal), `footnote_ref` (excludes code spans, `![^…]`, `[[^…]]`/refs inside wikilinks; def markers match too), `footnote_def` (≤3-space indent, tab counts 4; returns label, marker range, content start), `FootDef{label, display, at, refs}` (owned, cacheable), `footnotes()` (front-matter/fence aware, first-wins defs, refs attach case-insensitively, display numbered by first-ref order, first-seen casing incl. ref-before-def, continuations tracked implicitly, unclosed fence = not code), `count_footnotes()` cheap pre-scan (code spans not excluded → can only overcount, zero ⇒ empty), `footnote_flags()` downgrade (brackets lose DIM+LINK, label loses LINK only — emphasis preserved).
- `links_and_comments()`: brackets DIM, label LINK. `index()`: Footnote skipped. New `finds_footnotes` unit test.

**Editor:** `feet`/`feet_rev`/`foot_jump` fields + `feet()`/`foot_hash()` (labels only, positions excluded)/`foot_defined()`/`foot_keys()` (`mod.rs`); `footnote_target` (ref→`jump(def.at)`, def label→cycle `refs[]` via `foot_jump`, undefined→None) + `footnote_defined_at` + links/menu filtering (`mouse.rs`, `blocks.rs`); `LayoutKey.foot`/`Laid.foot`, plan() full-relayout on change, per-line style-id hash carries foot, `elided()` keeps labels but hides brackets, `footnote_flags` downgrade in shaping (`layout.rs`); `foot`+`defined` threaded through `grid::key/shape/rows/build/big_row/geometry` incl. table-cache hash (`grid.rs`); embed `LayoutKey` updated. Tables: LINK color, no elision, subs==0. No ↩ glyph. Shell `follow()` gets unreachable `Footnote` no-op arm; print `inline()` gets `Footnote` no-op arm (label renders, brackets hidden via DIM, no urls entry — behavior falls out automatically).

**Tests:** 2 new gpui layout tests (hide off-live/reveal on click, subs round-trip, Ctrl+click ref jump, def-label cycling incl. table-cell ref, undefined no-op, hand cursor; def-add restyles distant refs); sharing literal-passthrough cases; `export_pdf` footnote smoke test (weakened — see below).

## Verification
- `cargo check --locked` passes (via `CARGO_TARGET_DIR=/Users/sachinkoli/github/noteapp/target` since a fresh tree can't run gpui's `metal` shader step; check `cargo check` notes the pre-existing metal warning). Same 15 pre-existing warnings as base, none from this work.
- `cargo test`: markdown 37/37 ✓ (incl. new), sharing 6/6 ✓, layout 6/6 ✓ (incl. 2 new). Standalone `/tmp/mdtest` harness was used mid-work (since removed with the fix).
- `export_pdf::footnotes_print_in_place` **fails**: PDF streams are Flate-compressed so raw-byte body assertions don't work (existing suite only asserts metadata). The test currently asserts `%PDF-` + "the details." + no "Not printed" toast — needs rework (see below). Nothing committed, per constraints.

## REPORT list (for integrator)
- No shared registries changed (no Cargo.toml/Cargo.lock, no keymap/help touched — footnotes add no shortcut; no new deps).
- Additive-only: no table-grid code removed; print/sharing/canvas/diagram/embed/sync/update untouched except the two exhaustive-match arms. One overlap note: `grid::build/big_row/geometry/key/shape/rows` signatures gained `foot`/`defined` params — the table-trim crew should keep them (cache correctness depends on `foot`).
- Build-cache note: I set `CARGO_TARGET_DIR` to the parent repo's `target/` for check/test (approx +4G incremental growth there, no source touched). Disk filled twice during the work (freed /tmp leftovers + Homebrew cache); ~24G free now.

## Behavior notes / deviations
- Table-cell refs count in `refs` (cycling includes them) — spec-consistent.
- Print renders undefined refs label-only like defined ones (no definedness threading in print, per spec's print line).
- Sharing needed zero code changes (`emphasis`-only pass) — tests prove passthrough.
- `markdown_renderer.md` Q3 candidate syntax is now implemented; docs (`writing.md:21-34, :34`, renderer items, print-limits line, "Links in the text" Ctrl+click bullet) still need updating.
- `foot_defined`/`foot_keys` are linear scans (noted as fine for handfuls of defs).

## Open questions / remaining
1. Finish `export_pdf` test: assert via `print::words()`-style SVG extraction (a `print.rs` unit test on `inline()` checking bracket glyphs absent/label LINK/urls empty) + keep e2e as smoke.
2. Add `src/shell/tests/end_to_end/footnotes.rs` chapter + register in `end_to_end/mod.rs` (Ctrl+click jumps, cycling, undefined no-op, hand) — editor-level equivalents already pass.
3. Docs updates as above.
4. Suggested follow-up: run the full suite (`cargo test --locked`) when disk/time allow; the reuse fuzz test (`layout_reuse_matches_full_layout`) passed but only ran filtered subsets here.
